title: Protocol card
description: Fixed facts about one agent protocol. Every protocol in protocols/ has one card.json that conforms to this schema.

name.description: Full name as the upstream spec writes it.

abbreviation.description: Short name as the upstream spec writes it.

layer.description: Which two parties the protocol sits between. See README.md, Layers.

connects.description: Who talks to whom, in one sentence.

author.description: Company or group that first published the protocol.

steward.description: Body that governs the protocol today.

status.description: active: maintained. dormant: not archived, but no change to the spec for over a year. merged: folded into another protocol, see related. archived: upstream stopped.

version.description: Latest released spec version, as upstream names it.

released.description: Release date of that version, YYYY-MM-DD. Left out when upstream does not state it.

versioning.description: How upstream names versions. date: YYYY-MM-DD. semver: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. major-minor: MAJOR.MINOR. integer: one number per major version.

repository.description: URL of the upstream source repository.

schema.description: URL of the machine-readable schema (JSON Schema, OpenAPI, protobuf, type definitions).

license.description: SPDX identifier of the spec license.

related.description: Relations to other protocols in this collection.

relation.description: merged-into: this protocol continues as the other. extends: this protocol builds on the other. uses: this protocol carries or depends on the other. name-clash: same abbreviation, unrelated protocol.

checked.description: Date the card was last compared with upstream, YYYY-MM-DD.
